plan.fit: Exclude the entire target family. At each issued rate choose the ordering with highest equal-task mean gain. Break ties by actual lookups and name.
plan.fundingRule: After the witness phase, issue per-task credit from the number of eligible episodes. Reserve the full validation and maximum independent proof before starting one episode. Settle only actual lookups and return unused credit before considering the next episode.
plan.gate: At the primary rate require a positive paired subject-and-case lower endpoint over the trained blind order and over original CPO on every held-out family.
